item.title: Makereba Kanojo ga Zukobako Batsu Game
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Usagizuki
  • 発売日: 2010-09-04
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 負ければ彼女がズコバコ罰ゲーム
  • 英語名: Makereba Kanojo ga Zukobako Batsu Game

あらすじ

When the protagonist’s brother defaults on a debt of 100 million yen, the loan sharks come after him! But, thanks to his pretty girlfriend, he’s offered a chance to earn the money by participating in a quiz show. For each right answer, he earns money, but each wrong answer puts his girlfriend in dire straits…
